welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Phendula imibuzo embalwa mayelana nezimpawu zakho.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvakashelwa kwakho namarekhodi akho.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Ngiyabonga Ngizobuza imibuzo embalwa esheshayo mayelana nokuthi yini ekwenze wangena.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Faka impendulo, noma uchofoze isiphakamiso ngenhla

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Chofoza kunoma iyiphi into ukuze uyilungise ngaphambi kokuthumela.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Uma izimpawu zakho ziba zimbi kakhulu noma ziba zimbi kakhulu manje, ungalindi shayela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Sicela ufune ukunakekelwa kungakapheli amahora angu-12

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Izimpawu zakho zisho okuthile okufanele kubonwe maduze.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ithimba lomtholampilo lithola umlando wakho ohlelekile ngokushesha.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Uma isimo siba sibi kakhulu, yenza ngokushesha

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Ukuwohloka okukhulu noma okungazelelwe shayela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ngokushesha.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Lesi yisilinganiso esizenzakalelayo esiphuthumayo, hhayi isifo. Udokotela wenza isinqumo sokugcina.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Zivele ziqukethe amarekhodi akho, ngakho iqembu lakho lokunakekela libona umlando wakho ophelele ngokushesha.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Isitatimende sakho siphakathi kweqembu lokunakekelwa, sizokwazisa ngokushesha nje lapho udokotela esivula.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Uma isimo siba sibi kakhulu, yenza okuthile manje

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Uma izimpawu zakho ziba zimbi noma ziba zimbi ngokungazelelwe shayela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo manje noma uye emnyangweni wezimo eziphuthumayo oseduze.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Sikhombe icala lakho njengento ebaluleke kakhulu ukuze ithimba lokunakekelwa likwazi.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Udokotela uyabuyekeza ubuciko bakho, sizokutshela njengoba buqhubeka.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Phendula imibuzo embalwa mayelana nendlela oye waba ngayo kusukela ekuvakasheni kwakho.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ikhona yini enye ongathanda ukusitshela yona?

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Izimpawu zakho zisho okuthile okudinga ukunakwa ngokushesha. Ungalindi xhumana nethimba lakho lokunakekelwa noma uye emnyangweni wezimo eziphuthumayo oseduze.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Lokhu kulandelwa akusatholakali. Ngena ngemvume ukuze ubone ukubhalisa kwakho kwamanje.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Yenza i-akhawunti yamahhala ukuze ulandele ukuvakashelwa kwakho bese ugxuma ikhodi ngokuzayo.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Sizothumela ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa akukho iphasiwedi okufanele uyikhumbule.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: Ithunyelwe ku-{dest}, iphelelwa yisikhathi ngemva kwemizuzu eyishumi.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Faka ucingo lwakho noma i-imeyili bese sithumela ikhodi yokungena ngemvume.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: I-akhawunti yakho ixhunywe kumarekhodi esibhedlela sakho

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Iphutha lenethiwekhi, hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ukuze uphephe futhi uvikele idatha yeziguli zakho, ubhalisiwe ngemuva kwesikhathi sokungasebenzi.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Qala ukubhalisa ukuze uqale ukuvakashelwa okusha.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Izingcingo zokunakekelwa zihlale kulolu hlelo lokusebenza · inombolo yakho yocingo ayikaze yabelwe.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Khetha ukuthi ubani ozokubiza nokuthi kuzwakala kanjani.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Sawubona Jordan, sekuyisikhathi somthamo wakho wakusihlwa...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Ayikho izingcingo 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · ibuyela isaziso

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Ulayini wakho wokunakekelwa uhlala usebenza phinda ungene ukuze uphathe izingcingo nezikhumbuzo.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Ucingo olufihliwe · I-WebRTC · inombolo yakho ayikaze yabelwe

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Nguwe kuphela ongakubona lokhu kanye ne-{hospital}. Chofoza ukuvakashelwa ukuze ufunde isifinyezo esabelwe wena.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Asikho isidingo sokunakekela lokhu kuvakashelwa okwamanje.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Uma izimpawu zakho zibuyela emuva noma ziba zimbi, funa usizo oluphuthumayo ngokushesha.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Lokhu kuvakashelwa kungase kususwe, noma isixhumanisi singasebenzi.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Yazisa imininingwane yakho, udokotela wakho uzobona okusha.

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Igama lomuntu oxhumana naye esimweni esiphuthumayo

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ayikwazanga ukukopisha - khetha bese ukopisha ngesandla

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Igama lakho, imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana nezimpendulo zakho zetheksthi yamahhala ziyanyamalala ngaphambi kokuba noma yini iphume esibhedlela sakho.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Vumela idatha engaziwa ukuba ithuthukise ukunakekelwa kwawo wonke umuntu. Ungakushintsha lokhu nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Izikhumbuzo zesikhathi sokuqokwa nokuhlola okuqhubekayo ngokushayela ucingo noma ngokucindezela.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Khipha unomphela i-akhawunti yakho nemininingwane yakho yokuxhumana. Umlando wakho wokunakekelwa ugcinwa esibhedlela sakho njengoba kudingeka ngokomthetho.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Cela ikhophi yezifinyezo zakho zokuvakasha, imithi yakho, nomlando wakho wokubhekana nokunakekelwa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Lokhu kususa unomphela i-akhawunti yakho nemininingwane yakho yokuxhumana. Isibhedlela sakho sigcina umlando wakho womugqa wokunakekelwa njengoba kudingeka ngokomthetho. Lokhu akunakwenziwa.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ithimba lakho lokunakekelwa lizokuqinisekisa nge-imeyili kungakapheli amahora angu-72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Khetha ifomethi bese ucela ukuthekelisa, sizoyilungisa bese sithumela isixhumanisi esiphephile ku-imeyili yakho ebhalisiwe.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Sizokuthumela i-imeyili isixhumanisi esiphephile ekhelini lakho elibhalisiwe kungakapheli amahora angu-24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ayikho ifayela elilayishiwe lapha - amarekhodi akho athunyelwa ngokuphepha ku-imeyili yakho ebhalisiwe.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Unamathisele isixhumanisi sesimemo esivela esibhedlela sakho, noma uhlole ikhodi yabo ye-QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Lokho akubukeki njengesixhumanisi noma ikhodi yesimemo seTriavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Ikhodi yomtholampilo evumelekile ikuholela ngqo emininingwaneni yakho.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Ikhodi yomtholampilo evumelekile ikuyisa ngqo emininingwaneni yakho.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Nikeza imvume yekhamera kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho, noma ufake isixhumanisi sokumema ngesandla.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ayikho ikhamera etholakalayo, esikhundleni salokho faka isixhumanisi sesimemo esivela esibhedlela.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Ikhamera ayitholakali njengamanje. Faka isixhumanisi sememo ngesandla.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi? ukubonisa iskripthi sokuxoxisana esisindisiwe
